estimator_note: Memory integrals are exact discrete delayed trapezoidal recurrences up to float32 rounding. They estimate the unobserved native-step integral; feasibility and all reported Q values use the original evaluator accepted-step integration. The energy loop compares matched target and fusion quadratures.
q_calibration_note: Gain scheduling uses only past noisy q_min observations, averaged during the first 7.5 seconds; the midpoint is calibrated from the two public native radial resolutions. This numerical-model calibration is explicit; no scenario/seed identifier is supplied to the graph.
